items.name: Date Order
items.note: Whether the day or the month comes first in the dates you type. Dates starting with the year, like 2003-11-17, always work, and . / - all work as separators

items.name: Timestamp Style
items.note: How the converted times and dates are shown. Relative times like "in 5 min" always count from now

items.name: Dates Without a Year
items.note: Converts dates like 17.11. to this year. Turn it off if prices or versions like 12.05. get converted by mistake

items.name: Apply to Message Edits
items.note: Whether to also convert timestamps when editing messages
